bidCost.notes: Varies by category, region and request density, shown on the send screen and charged only when sent; exact per-category values unknown. Up to 10 quotes per request. A quote unread after 48 hours is refunded as bonus cash. 자동견적 is free. Request-detail pricing pilot 2026-11-15 to 2026-11-30 in the Seoul metro.

splitMechanism: 숨고페이 takes 15,000 to 5,000,000 KRW per payment and up to 50 payments per chat room; from the 5th payment the previous one must be confirmed and 96 hours must have passed. Deposit and balance are separate payments. 숨고페이 is optional.

contactPolicy.notes: Contact details, SNS, blog or portal-search lures in the profile, quote or nickname are removed at once and three repeats restrict the account. Phone contact goes through 안심번호, valid 7 days from the quote. Phone or account numbers typed in chat are checked against a fraud DB.

payout: 숨고페이 settlement to a registered bank account whose holder matches the verified name or business; funds released after 거래확정, deposited within 1 hour.
